text: i dont see the live gameplay readings where are they ? am i looking in the wrong place
resolution: Fixed 'I don't see the live gameplay fps readings.' The HUD added in req_1674 was gated behind RJIT_FPS=1, so launching 'rjit game play' normally showed nothing. Diagnosed the env path (tools/rjit execs, __spawnSync inherits env, play() aborts on build failure) and confirmed propagation actually works — the real friction was just that it required an env var the user didn't set. Fix: the HUD now defaults ON whenever build_options.use_v8 is false (i.e. THIS binary is the compiled no-V8 game, whose own window always wants an fps counter) and stays OFF for the V8 editor; RJIT_FPS=0 force-hides and RJIT_FPS/RJIT_PERFLOG force-show as overrides. Implemented entirely in framework/gpu/3d.zig via @import(build_options) + @hasDecl guard. Verified: rebuilt the no-V8 loader clean and 'rjit game shot' with NO env var renders the HUD top-left (fps/draw/inst/restage/dc). So 'rjit game play' now shows fps automatically.
